title: Lake Tahoe ATV Tour to a Hidden Alpine Lake on a 2 seater ATV
blurb:
Explore Lake Tahoe’s backcountry on a guided 13-mile round-trip ATV adventure to a hidden alpine lake. Ride approximately 6.5 miles from the trailhead to the lake and 6.5 miles back, experiencing uneven mountain trails, changing elevations, scenic viewpoints, and time to enjoy the secluded lake.

Each booking includes a two-person ATV, allowing two guests to share one machine. No previous ATV experience or driver’s license is required. Every driver receives a complete safety briefing and supervised practice session before entering the trail.

The price includes your two-person ATV, professional guide, full-face helmets, fuel, applicable entrance fees, a stop at the hidden alpine lake, and round-trip shuttle transportation from the Adventure Lake Tahoe office or selected Stateline/South Lake Tahoe pickup locations. This is a complete guided backcountry experience rather than a short ATV rental or unguided ride.
